title: Green Rewards Card: Carbon Reporting for Business Accounting
summary: This document explains how to produce Green Rewards Card carbon and sustainability reports on a monthly schedule, export executive summaries and detailed accounting files for month/quarter-end close, and reconcile category emissions/offsets to general ledger accounts using transaction-level details. It also covers audit readiness via retained exports/supporting documentation and internal policy requirements for using offsets in corporate disclosures, plus workflow integration and approval steps.
faqs: How often are carbon and sustainability reports produced for Green Rewards Card accounting?
What files should I export for executive reporting versus detailed accounting, and when do I include them in close checklists?
How do I reconcile category-level emissions and offsets to the general ledger?
What transaction-level details are used to substantiate sustainability journal entries?
What should I retain to be audit ready, and what internal policies must exist regarding offsets in disclosures?
How should I align expense categories and set up a workflow to review/approve the monthly file before posting?
